message: You know that one friend who always seems to panic at the first sign of a storm? I like to think of myself as the calm one in the room, but even I appreciate a little guidance when the skies start looking ominous. The Red Cross has some great tips on how to prepare for hurricanes, which is a handy reminder that a little planning can go a long way in keeping us all relaxed. Have you ever had to weather a storm unexpectedly? How did you handle it?
